    Project settings

    Open Edit > Project Settings > NKStudio > Custom Toolbar. Settings are stored per project in ProjectSettings/CustomToolbarSettings.asset.

    Setting Purpose Default
    Show Enter Play Mode Shows the Enter Play Mode Options toggle. On
    Show Scene Switcher Shows the first-scene button and scene menu. On
    Show Time Scale Shows the time scale control. On
    Show Localization Shows the optional Localization menu. On
    Show FMOD Debug Shows the optional FMOD Debug toggle. On
    Scene Search Folders Selects the Assets folders searched by the scene menu. Assets/Scenes
    Minimum Time Scale Sets the slider's minimum value. 0
    Maximum Time Scale Sets the slider's maximum value. 5
    Reset Time Scale Sets the value used by the reset action. 1

    Scene folder paths are normalized when saved. The maximum time scale cannot be lower than the minimum, and the reset value is clamped to that range.
